fields.title: Introducing Django CI
fields.description: A short introduction to setting up CI for Django projects.
fields.content: This post explains how to set up GitHub Actions to run migrations, tests, and build Docker images for a Django project.

fields.title: Healthy Routines for Remote Developers

fields.content: Stand up regularly, take short walks, and keep a consistent sleep schedule. Ergonomics matter.
